Clinical Profile & Mission

About Charak Health Solutions

Specialized Non-Surgical Ayurvedic Pain Management & Joint Preservation

Charak Health Solutions is a dedicated Ayurvedic medical clinic in Thane West, Maharashtra, founded and directed by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya (BAMS, MD Clinical Ayurveda). The clinic specializes in preventing knee replacement and spinal surgeries through evidence-backed classical Ayurveda, vital Marma point stimulation, and specialized Panchakarma therapies.

Our Core Clinical Mission

To restore pain-free natural mobility, rebuild synovial fluid lubrication, and decompress pinched spinal nerves without lifetime painkiller dependency or invasive surgery.

About the Chief Physician: Dr. Surabhi Vaidya

Dr. Surabhi Vaidya holds a Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) and a Doctor of Medicine (MD) in Clinical Ayurveda, backed by over 15 years of dedicated clinical practice. Having treated over 3,000 complex joint and spine cases, Dr. Surabhi is renowned for her transparent, diagnostic-first approach to conditions like:

  • Knee Osteoarthritis (Sandhivata): Cartilage degeneration, joint stiffness, and walking difficulty.
  • Sciatica & Lumbar Disc Herniation (Gridhrasi): L4-L5/L5-S1 disc bulges and radiating nerve pain.
  • Cervical Spondylosis (Manyastambha): Neck stiffness, vertigo, and numbness in arms.
  • Frozen Shoulder (Apabahuka) & Chronic Musculoskeletal Distress.

Our 4-Pillar Clinical Framework

  • 1. Vital Marma Point Decompression: Targeted stimulation of neuromuscular points to unlock restricted joints and ease nerve entrapment.
  • 2. Deep Panchakarma & Medicated Oils: Warm herbal oil reservoirs that nourish cartilage, increase joint space, and reduce inflammation.
  • 3. Classical Internal Formulations: Standardized, heavy-metal tested classical herbal medicines customized according to patient constitution (Prakriti).
  • 4. Structural Ergonomics & Lifestyle Correction: Gentle rehabilitative exercises to prevent recurrence and maintain joint longevity.
